summary: Implemented scripts/gc-worktrees.js: conservative, dependency-free worktree GC sweep, DRY-RUN by default (--confirm executes, --retention-hours default 24). Classifies each worktrees/<bucket>/<slug> + empty parent dirs as EMPTY/ACTIVE/NEEDS-ATTENTION/GC-ELIGIBLE using bounded spawnSync git probes (worktree list --porcelain, status --porcelain, rev-list --count main..HEAD); any probe failure -> NEEDS-ATTENTION (never deleted). --confirm GCs only EMPTY + GC-ELIGIBLE (worktree remove --force + branch -D), then git worktree prune. node --check passes. DRY RUN verified: all 4 self/* (code-repo-target, slim-full-graph, smoke-git-merge = 1 unmerged commit each; onboarding-kb = 7 uncommitted) classify NEEDS-ATTENTION; only stale unregistered worktrees/926c26ecd4552541/k-a (defunct temp gitdir, clean+merged) is GC-ELIGIBLE. No --confirm run, no commit.
